name: my-antigravity
description: Custom desktop plugin loader and modular UX plugins for Antigravity.

scripts.build: node plugins/zh-cn/build.mjs && node plugins/session-status/build.mjs && node plugins/model-enhancer/build.mjs && node plugins/quota-rings/build.mjs && node plugins/taskbar-badge/build.mjs && node plugins/dino-game/build.mjs && node plugins/mod-manager/build.mjs
scripts.sync: npm run build && node loader/cli.mjs sync
scripts.install-loader: npm run build && node loader/cli.mjs install
